title: wg: ext-10 §4.9 vs §5 SafeAAD framing contradiction
description: Erratum. draft-ietf-mls-extensions-10 §4.9 says 'the entire authenticated_data field is framed as a SafeAAD struct'; §5 says it 'always starts with the SafeAAD struct'. 'Starts with' permits trailing non-safe bytes, 'entire' forbids them; -09 allowed them. mimid rejects trailing bytes (decision mimid-1wgh.4.17). Fix: make §5 say 'is framed entirely as'. Found drafting mimid-1wgh.37.40.
